key_insight: MOTIF improves out-of-distribution materials prediction by using LLMs to propose chemical taxonomies rather than predict properties directly.
engineering_relevance: More robust prediction across unfamiliar chemistries could support perovskite materials screening, with transfer evaluated on 3D perovskite solar-cell efficiencies.
method: Generate candidate material taxonomies with LLMs.
Retain taxonomies that improve training-only pseudo-OOD validation.
Select invariant features within accepted taxonomies and combine predictions through gated aggregation.
evidence_signal: On 2D halide perovskites, mean OOD bandgap MAE fell from 0.122 to 0.111 eV; frozen dev/test evaluation also showed smaller gains for electronic and optical bandgaps.
watch_item: Benefits depend on taxonomy quality and validation splits that reflect deployment shifts; bandgap improvements do not directly establish better device performance.
paper_title: MOTIF: LLM-Defined Material Taxonomies for OOD Property Prediction via Invariant Feature Selection
